release.changeNote: Reference-input audit fixes (docs/model-reference-inputs-audit-2026-09-04.md). Pricing: grok-imagine-video passes Kie's listed 2.4 / 4.5 credits per second through (was 1.6 / 3, a third under Kie's current rate); seedance-1.5-pro 480p 12s follows Kie's per-second rates at 21 / 42 (was 19 / 38); veo-3.1 quality 4K text-to-video bills Kie's listed 370 (was 380); minimax-h3 keeps the reference-adjustment shape the previous release introduced, now emitted from code rather than edited by hand. Validation: gpt-image-2 renders 5:4 and 4:5 at 1K only; wan-2.7 reference-to-video runs cap at the 10 s its r2v endpoint accepts; every model whose provider reads frames positionally (Seedance family, Wan, Kling 3.0, Veo) refuses an end frame without a start frame at quote time, MiniMax H3 excepted because its image endpoint accepts either; Seedance 2 / Fast / Mini and minimax-h3 enforce Kie's 15 s combined reference-audio ceiling on clients that report audio durations; kling-2.6 motion keeps image orientation to Kie's 10 s. Caps, descriptors, availability and adapters are unchanged; the Seedance 2.5 clip guard fix and the kling-3.0/video element_input_urls rename ship in code.
